g.text: transaction: the deposit and all its transfers are
recorded together or not at all (DR-05).
Every transfer records the depositing client as its
actor and the deposit as its cause.
7 : create(deposit, to: router, sender, message, amount, actor)
9 : rules in order of position, remainder account
12 : floor(amount × percentage / 100), or the fixed amount
14 : create(transfer, to: target, take, actor, cause: deposit)
16 : create(transfer, to: remainder, left, actor, cause: deposit)
[for each rule, in order of position]
